INTRODUCTION

The Government of Tamil Nadu has a

pragmatic liquor policy which focusses on

safeguarding the weaker and vulnerable sections

of society against the evils of illicit liquor to

ensure their health and socio-economic

well-being.

The Prohibition and Excise Department

functions under the administrative control of the

Home, Prohibition and Excise Department. Three

Head of Departments and a state public sector

undertaking are functioning under the Prohibition

and Excise wing of Home Department:

1

1. The Commissionerate of Prohibition and Excise;

2. Prohibition Enforcement Wing;

3. Narcotic Intelligence Bureau - CID; and

4. Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation Limited (TASMAC).

2. COMMISSIONERATE OF PROHIBITION AND EXCISE

2.1 The Commissioner of Prohibition and

Excise oversees the enforcement of the

Tamil Nadu Prohibition Act, 1937 (Tamil Nadu Act

X of 1937) and the rules framed thereunder. The

primary Goals include:
